title: SciPy minimize(method=SLSQP) reference
actual_reading: Downloaded SciPy reference text lines 115-162 (SLSQP, ftol, maxiter and numerical-Jacobian options), 180-248 (OptimizeResult success/message, KKT and constraint conversion). Selected API reference reading only, not a full numerical-optimization literature review.
use: Explicit inequality constraints with supplied analytic objective/constraint Jacobians; cap actual evaluations independently of maxiter; verify physical feasibility after solver success.
limitations: Current website describes newer SciPy features; local SciPy is 1.15.3. Only established fun/jac/bounds/ineq/ftol/maxiter API used; no workers/multipliers dependency.
SLSQP is a shared classical tool, not LLM innovation and not a global-optimality guarantee.
1e-6m interior margin, scaling, ftol and budgets are frozen engineering choices, not published UAV guarantees.
Internal SLSQP trials can violate nonlinear constraints; final acceptance still uses the original hard region check.
